subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should follow-up work preserve the current `gateway.nodes.allowCommands` and node approval boundaries while fixing Android command advertising/A2UI readiness, or intentionally change the camera/location exposure policy?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and current source shows both command implementations and security gates; automation cannot safely decide whether to broaden exposure from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run current-main Android proof, keep `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` behind explicit gateway authorization, and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

options.title: Change exposure policy
options.body: Broaden Android camera or location exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after repro
options.body: If live proof shows independent causes, split camera, location, and A2UI work into separate owner-reviewed follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run current-main Android proof, keep `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` behind explicit gateway authorization, and fix only reproduced advertising, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily Android app behavior plus sensitive node capability exposure, and obviyus is the documented Android app maintainer with prior live capability-test work.
